statement: A presentation-only fix that names an absence is still an assertion, so derive it from what the scanner withheld as well as what it read. Fixing #520, the reviewing agent changed A4's note from 'a lockfile is not required' to 'CI requires a lockfile and none is committed'. The planted fixture passed. The before/after on the public board then showed fastapi carries uv.lock, which the file walk withholds because it exceeds the 512,000-byte content limit, so the new note would have stated a false absence, and the prospective v27 metric would have scored it 0. Rule: before a sentence says something is missing, check the withheld-path register as well as the scanned inventory, and run the change over real repositories, not only the fixture built for it.
